name: Infinite Guideline
description: Infinite Guideline is Pinnacle's neutral eternity-column station and main transit hub in the Sothera system.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

description_citations.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

summary.text: Infinite Guideline is Pinnacle's neutral eternity-column station and main transit hub in the Sothera system.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

citations.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

bio.text: Pinnacle came to Sothera after the Kav's emigration, built the eternity column Infinite Guideline and opened the system to the Edge.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

bio.text: As the Free Company and Monoists massed fleets toward it, Mantis noted that Pinnacle stays neutral and can only deny passage through the column, and she resigned as director with Checkmate inheriting the post.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

bio.text: The Seriema reached the station carrying the Endstone, a ceasefire let both sides crowd toward it, and Pinnacle placed the ship under tacit arrest.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

bio.text: The station was holed by tiny punctures, boarded by Monoists and Solar Knights, and invaded by elds that fed on Sunstar and Pinnacle forces.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

bio.text: There Vondam cast Haliya out of the Free Company, and she disabled him with Alpharael's help.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

bio.text: Finally the eternity column opened to let the Seriema into warp, and the crew used the station to warp their pursuers away to the Wurmwall.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: As of the latest story the station is damaged by the siege, but it remained Pinnacle's eternity column and opened for the Seriema's escape.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
"Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret meets the crew and a dice roll sends them to Infinite Guideline Station.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret found that it wanted them to go to Infinite Guideline Station

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alpharael and Haliya duel Vondam together and win; the crew warps to the Wurmwall, where the Vaar take the Endstone.
timeline.quote: the Endstone was taken away by the Vaar

citation.text: "Alpharael", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vondam fights Haliya and Alpharael and is disabled, begging to be finished; they leave.
timeline.quote: Haliya separated the vertebrae in Vondam's neck

citation.text: "Vondam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle, drawn by the Kav's furious emigration, comes to Sothera, builds the eternity column Infinite Guideline and opens the system to the Edge.
timeline.quote: We came to Sothera, constructed an FTL outpost—an eternity column designated Infinite Guideline —and opened the system to the rest of the connected Edge.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Noz thanks Kadrik and invites him to visit Guideline before leaving.
timeline.quote: Maybe you can even visit me on Guideline.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Kadrik and the Pod" by Kemi Ashing-Giwa. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen arrives at Infinite Guideline seeking a ship with a drive and a codebook for her pilgrimage.
timeline.quote: And her obligate pilgrimage will take her even farther—that is, if she ever finds a half-decent ship with a drive and a codebook.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A malfunctioning scavenger mechan tries to eat Reen's oversized suitcase and she throws it aside.
timeline.quote: a malfunctioning scavenger mechan trying to eat her oversized suitcase, drawn to its metal-rich contents.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Kav captain refuses to take Reen to Point Prime directly.
timeline.quote: "Point Prime from here?" he demands.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen finds that captains fear the route to Point Prime and begins to doubt her pilgrimage.
timeline.quote: Point Prime is far, yes. But distance is the least of the captains' concerns.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The mechan captain Too Much Happiness reveals it is also going to Point Prime.
timeline.quote: "What serendipity," it says.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Reen books passage with Too Much Happiness.
timeline.quote: She puts in her offer. The transfer and contract blink through.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Compact Me to Zero" by Rich Larson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis learns that six thousand died on Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Six thousand dead on Kavaron.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis reflects that the Free Company violated its agreement with Pinnacle and that Pinnacle stays neutral.
timeline.quote: The Free Company has violated the terms of its agreement with Pinnacle.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis tells Checkmate that Pinnacle can only deny passage through the eternity column.
timeline.quote: We have no power to arrest or pursue the guilty.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis deduces that a Monoist warship is within Pinnacle's controlled space.
timeline.quote: There is a Monoist warship inside our controlled space,

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam, in Pinnacle custody, is questioned by Mantis.
timeline.quote: He surrendered his ship to the Kav, without contest, on the condition that he be delivered directly to Infinite Guideline and Pinnacle custody.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam warns that both sides will blockade the eternity column.
timeline.quote: That they must blockade the eternity column and prevent any ship from escaping Sothera.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam tells Mantis an artifact is present in Sothera that the enemy cannot obtain.
timeline.quote: We have discovered that there is an artifact present in Sothera which we cannot permit the enemy to obtain.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis resigns as director of Infinite Guideline and Checkmate inherits the post.
timeline.quote: I resign my post as director of the Infinite Guideline effective immediately.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam describes an unstable double stalemate as both fleets move toward Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: We are in an unstable double stalemate.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis asks whether Vondam would destroy the station to stop the artifact, and he says yes.
timeline.quote: Would you destroy this station and the eternity column, trapping yourself in Sothera, in order to prevent the artifact from escaping?

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam predicts his former student will come to Infinite Guideline to steal an eternity drive.
timeline.quote: Infinite Guideline has an eternity column, and it is the only place in the system with eternity drive ferries that can lift her ship into warp.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Fleets from both sides accelerate toward Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: Dozens of fusion-drive flames are accelerating toward Infinite Guideline and the eternity column.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret plans to sell the Endstone to its maker, using Mm'menon's ship to boost the Seriema to Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: We will take the Endstone there, and I will sell it to its maker in exchange for a glimpse of their power.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami lays out a plan for Haliya and Alpharael to steal a warp ferry from Infinite Guideline's docking arms.
timeline.quote: Haliya and Alpharael will use armor to leap from the Seriema to one of the harbormaster modules at the end of Infinite Guideline's docking arms.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael identifies a mass leech called a myzoformine approaching the Seriema.
timeline.quote: A mass leech. Sometimes they just point you out for investigation. Sometimes they kill you.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema falls toward Infinite Guideline at fifty kilometers a second.
timeline.quote: They are falling toward the Infinite Guideline , glittering all alone in the dark, at a handsome fifty kilometers a second.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company bid with speed to reach Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: The Monoists and the Sunstar Company are in a bidding war, and they are paying with speed.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya reluctantly aligns her Sunstar frequency-hopper so the Seriema can listen to Free Company traffic.
timeline.quote: It takes some verbal fencing before Haliya is willing to align her Sunstar Company frequency-hopper with the Seriema 's receiver.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The crew watches a distant space battle in which a ship is hit.
timeline.quote: Someone was hit, and died, or lived.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle lases the shadow shields of palestars braking too close, and the Monoists kill them.
timeline.quote: A pair of Sunstar patrol ships try to brake too close to Guideline, and Pinnacle shows its teeth

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami sends a recorded message to Infinite Guideline offering information and requesting guidance.
timeline.quote: We are inbound. We offer gifts of information and request your guidance.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael broadcasts to the Monoists that he carries a thing sent by INEVITA and asks help reaching the warp.
timeline.quote: I am Alpharael of Secundi, kamu-shiku, chosen by the singularity.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The fighting continues around but does not touch the Seriema.
timeline.quote: But the fighting does not touch the Seriema.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami declines to ask for mallowmass so that Infinite Guideline is not put at risk.
timeline.quote: We are under other protection.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema reaches Infinite Guideline.
timeline.quote: They make it to Infinite Guideline .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A ceasefire lets both sides crowd toward Infinite Guideline to receive the Endstone and destroy pursuers.
timeline.quote: Under cover of a ceasefire—to retrieve survivors, make repairs, and limp away—both sides crowd in toward Infinite Guideline, waiting to receive the Endstone from the Seriema and destroy its pursuers.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle places the Seriema under tacit arrest.
timeline.quote: The Seriema is under tacit arrest.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami meets Checkmate Mantis on the dock.
timeline.quote: "You must be Checkmate Mantis," Sami says

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami tells Mantis the whole story of the artifact unearthed at Sigma.
timeline.quote: I have come into possession of an artifact unearthed from the clay of Sigma.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk presents a memory crystal with the Seriema's full recording of Kavaron.
timeline.quote: Tannuk takes a knee and presents, in an outstretched claw, a quartz memory crystal.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis reveals Vondam came to confess and warn Pinnacle about the battle over the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Syr Vondam came to us to confess his crimes and warn us to evacuate Infinite Guideline .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis says the artifact should be given to the Drix.
timeline.quote: I mean the Drix.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis reveals that a Drix named Barrow arrived two days ago.
timeline.quote: A Drix seamed in two days ago.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis admits Vondam persuaded her lethal force might be justified but she has not used it.
timeline.quote: Checkmate Mantis draws a long, low drone from her legs. "Yes."

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The dock loses power and light as an unseen attack pierces it.
timeline.quote: The lights go out. The air pumps stop. The dock plunges into darkness.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sonar shows the dock has been holed in many places by tiny punctures.
timeline.quote: The dock has been holed in several places.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis identifies potential matter being pumped into the station.
timeline.quote: "Potential matter," Checkmate Mantis says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael, drifting toward the tug quay in armor, find the warp ferries are gone.
timeline.quote: I don't want to declare defeat too soon. But the ferries are gone.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Infinite Guideline springs leaks and loses its aurorae as Monoist mechans dock at punctures.
timeline.quote: Infinite Guideline has just sprung leaks. A lot of leaks.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Solar Knights launch lightbridge boarding craft at Guideline.
timeline.quote: The Solar Knights are making a play for Guideline.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya spots a many-limbed shape headed for the dock where the Seriema is moored.
timeline.quote: It has a lot of limbs.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A looping, topologically strange alien enters the dock through a hole.
timeline.quote: It is beautiful. It is a loop. It has no inside or outside.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis orders self-defense and the mechans shred the alien, which recovers.
timeline.quote: "Sanctioned self-defense!" Mantis orders, and the mechans open fire.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The alien licks a war mechan clean, graphing its components into chalky lattice.
timeline.quote: It licks the mechan clean.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Alpharael crash into the tug quay and enter the station.
timeline.quote: They crash into the tug quay and stick.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael recites random numbers hoping the Endstone will make his guess a correct ferry code, and it is rejected.
timeline.quote: You thought you'd guess randomly, then, in the future, you'd get the Endstone and make your guess correct!

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya insists on returning to the Free Company to report and beg Alpharael's pardon.
timeline.quote: I'm going to make my report and beg your pardon.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam appears on the control deck and says he acted in accordance with the Sum except when he let Haliya go out of love.
timeline.quote: I did act in accordance with the Sum. Except when I let you go. I did that out of love.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam, helmet open and bladiators ready, stands between them and the airlock.
timeline.quote: He is here. Standing on the far side of the control deck. Between them and the airlock.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam calls on Haliya to come home and take the Endstone.
timeline.quote: Come home, Haliya.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 10" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis's last war mechan carries Sami, Tannuk and Mantis up the docking arm away from an eld.
timeline.quote: The last surviving war mechan has seized all three of them and now boosts them up the spinal shaft of Infinite Guideline's number-three docking arm, away from the Seriema and the alien.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A second eld erupts into their path.
timeline.quote: Another alien erupts into their path.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mantis sacrifices her mechan to divert an eld and hurls Sami and Tannuk to an old ship hulk with a reactor.
timeline.quote: And before either of them can protest, the mechan hurls Sami and Tannuk at the ship hulk.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle's Tactical Corps personnel independently decide to release their violence delegates.
timeline.quote: Release the violence delegates.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle's mechan swarms target the radiators of the faiths' warships.
timeline.quote: Their target is the most vulnerable part of any warship—the radiators.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Cataline burns through the Thinner's miracho Yamno, killing his armor.
timeline.quote: Modest Cataline burns him through and through, hot spot to cold exit, and the beam kills his armor in one blow.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Thinner grips the tapped-out Cataline in his tides.
timeline.quote: Then the Thinner, fate's armorer, grips the tapped-out Cataline in his tides.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Cataline's squire Isidor is flensed by the tides.
timeline.quote: now he's scraped flat by the tides—flensed of his outer parts.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The hunger from space feeds on both Sunstar and Pinnacle forces but never on Monoists.
timeline.quote: But it does not feed on Monoists.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam tells Haliya he should have killed her when she begged him to and urges her to live with failure.
timeline.quote: I should've killed you when you begged me to.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam cuts the boots off Alpharael's armor.
timeline.quote: Alpharael tries to move and Vondam, without looking, cuts the bulky, elevated boots of his suit off.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam pleads with Haliya to return to the faith.
timeline.quote: "Come back," he pleads.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya refuses to return home with the stone as a hero and explains the Sum must account for her revolt.
timeline.quote: I will not go home with the stone and be a hero.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya drives Vondam off Alpharael with her bladiator.
timeline.quote: She thrusts her long-handled bladiator from the hip and drives Syr Vondam off.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam formally degrades Haliya and bars her from knighthood.
timeline.quote: by my authority as a knight of the company, I hereby degrade you.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya is cast out of the Free Company and chooses to believe her choice was right.
timeline.quote: He has cast her out of the Free Company.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: An eld goes after Mantis and her combat mechan.
timeline.quote: The monster goes after Checkmate Mantis and her combat mechan.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The eld has eaten Mantis's war mechan, which Sami sees as a graph of its components.
timeline.quote: It is a graph of the war mechan's components, spread in three dimensions. The thing has eaten it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami opens a stasis cask and finds their lost cat Mirri.
timeline.quote: "Mirri?" Sami gasps.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami realizes Mirri weftwalked into a stasis cask on a similar ship and was frozen in time.
timeline.quote: She weftwalked away from the Seriema when she was startled and went to a ship that looked almost like the Seriema and landed in a stasis cask.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Mirri yowls and weftwalks away from the approaching eld.
timeline.quote: Mirri yowls and vanishes. Weftwalks away.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami and Tannuk electrocute the eld by shorting a power cable down its mouth.
timeline.quote: A spectacular buzz. A flash of fire. Power arcs through the thing's matter.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The second eld hits Tannuk from the side.
timeline.quote: The second creature hits him from the side.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya and Vondam fight a sparring-style duel on the control deck.
timeline.quote: "Tally-ho," Vondam says, mildly.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam says protocol dictated the slaughter, convincing Haliya that the fault lies in the Sum.
timeline.quote: I had to. Protocol dictated it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya concludes the fault is not in Vondam or herself but in the Sum.
timeline.quote: The fault is not in him, or in her. It is in the Sum.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya embraces Vondam and, using the hole in Alpharael's hand, jabs her thumb into the back of his neck.
timeline.quote: Haliya embraces him and jabs her right thumb into the hole in Alpharael's hand.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya pops apart Vondam's vertebrae.
timeline.quote: She digs her thumb into his vertebrae and pops them apart.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Barrow's staff burns the eld attacking Tannuk and destroys it.
timeline.quote: The new flesh is burning .

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Drix introduces itself as Tumulus, or Barrow, a sentinel at the cofferdam.
timeline.quote: I am called Tumulus, or Barrow. I am a sentinel at the cofferdam.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Barrow says it saved Mantis and now must hunt.
timeline.quote: I have saved the beautiful insect and delivered her to her post.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Barrow unseams space and vanishes.
timeline.quote: Barrow is gone.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tannuk calms Sami's panic and Sami decides what to do next.
timeline.quote: I can't decide what to do next. I need you to do it for me.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya cuts Vondam's nerve interface, leaving him helpless.
timeline.quote: But his squire reaches through the hole in her enemy's hand and cuts her knight's nerve interface away.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya makes her report to Vondam and asks pardon for Alpharael.
timeline.quote: I have made my report,

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam demands that Haliya kill him but she cannot do what the Sum asks.
timeline.quote: She cannot do what the Sum asks.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya places herself on errantry, still a Summist but cast out of the Free Company.
timeline.quote: I've been cast out of the Free Company, but I am still a Summist. I place myself on errantry.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A Monoist gravkill paladin has taken the Seriema.
timeline.quote: The worshippers of INEVITA have taken the Seriema.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami stabs the Monoist armor in the chest.
timeline.quote: They stab the Monoist right in the chest.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The paladin says the Monoists will aid the Endstone if it goes through the eternity column.
timeline.quote: The Endstone has come here, to the eternity column. If it wishes to go through the eternity column, then it will, and we will aid it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball of alabile, apparently killed by Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The gravkill paladin collapses into a crumpled ball, like crushed foil.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under warship scrutiny.
timeline.quote: Alpharael and Haliya fly back to the Seriema under the terrifying scrutiny of warships.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya says she cannot believe Alpharael guessed the ferry code.
timeline.quote: I still can't believe you guessed that code,

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael realizes a cherazad has frozen the battle.
timeline.quote: "Tactical event horizon," he realizes.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Sami jerks the Seriema free and drives at Infinite Guideline to force a game of chicken.
timeline.quote: With a drumbeat of thruster fire, they jerk the Seriema free of the mooring.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The eternity column opens, letting the Seriema into warp.
timeline.quote: Key meets lock. Eternity opens.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kav scrappers send Val's ship crashing onto an unexplored jungle world.
timeline.quote: Val has transmitted this message daily ever since a fateful run-in with Kav scrappers sent her ship hurtling to the surface of an unexplored jungle world.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema docks with Tezzeret's ship, where he wants to see what the Endstone will influence them to do; it leads them to Infinite Guideline Station.
timeline.quote: Random chance revealed to them that it wanted to go to Infinite Guideline Station

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Monoists, Summists and Eldrazi converge on the station for the stone; the crew uses the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall.
timeline.quote: but they managed to use the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall.

citation.text: "Endstone", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Infinite Guideline Station Vondam casts Haliya out of the Free Company; she subdues him.
timeline.quote: she was stopped by Syr Vondam, who cast her out of the Free Company

citation.text: "Haliya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crew takes the Endstone to Infinite Guideline Station, uses the station to warp enemies into the Wurmwall, and Sami recovers Mirri.
timeline.quote: they managed to use the station to warp them out into the Wurmwall

citation.text: "Sami", section "Hunt for the Endstone". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Seriema docks with Tezzeret's ship and the stone chooses Infinite Guideline Station.
timeline.quote: Chance indicated Infinite Guideline Station

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A battle at the station; Sami's group warps enemies into the Wurmwall and Sami recovers Mirri.
timeline.quote: Sami also recovered their missing cat Mirri from a stasis cask aboard the station

citation.text: "Mission for the Endstone", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle comes to Sothera, builds Infinite Guideline and opens the system to the Edge.
timeline.quote: Pinnacle came to Sothera, constructed an FTL outpost

citation.text: "Sothera", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
